title: August 1940 session, 'If I Had a Ribbon Bow' and Kirby sets
summary: Four sides including two takes of 'Ribbon Bow', and where they appear on Kirby albums.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Anyway, you recorded again four sides on the 1st of August.

Yeah. By this time, Lou Singer was -- you know, we were right into the thick of the thing with Lou Singer. And Lou wrote "If I Had A Ribbon Bow" for me. That was one of his selections. I don't have any of these recordings at all, but I remember. They were released --
Shall we read the titles?

Yes. "If I Had A Ribbon Bow," which became very popular for me; "Who Is Sylvia," "Molly Malone" and "Barbara Allen." Now these are all the folk-type things we did with the Kirby treatment. Because Lou Singer was not only doing a little research for me picking up these numbers, he also did the arrangements too.

Yeah. Well fortunately, the 78's may be hard to come by. And again, these I received from the Institute of Jazz Studies. But "If I Had I Ribbon Bow," two versions of that appeared on one playing record recently.

I think the original of "If I Had A Ribbon" -- it's not the original.
On the Kirby's release --
That's take two --
Yeah, uh hum. "If I Had A Ribbon Bow" is in there, and I think "Molly Malone."
No, I don't think so.
No?
Just that one. And --
"Loch Lomond," right? On Kirby's thing? I don't know, you'd have to --
The other songs of yours on the John Kirby album is "Nice Work If You Can Get It."
Oh, I see.
But there's also a four record set on Columbia called "Swing Street," which has a different take of "If I Had A Ribbon Bow," in it. It has the first take.
Yeah.
There's not much difference between them.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
The difference would be that one version might be the one we did in 1955 on the Flow Gently Sweet Rhythm album. No?
No, no. These are just two different takes that was recorded on the same day.
Oh, I see, yeah.
But it's nice to have both of them available.
Yeah.
